messages:
Asha Mehta: Quick design review note: in the compact compare table the version-pin affordance disappears when badges collapse. Users report not realizing a row is pinned after density=compact.
Logan Price: noticed this during usability testing. users missed pins when scanning quickly.
Tao Chen: current behavior: pin icon lives in the badge column which is hidden in compact mode. We could: (A) show a 2px left accent stripe for pinned rows, (B) render a tiny persistent dot at row start, or (C) keep a small pin glyph always visible. Thoughts?
Maya Bennett: prefer the left stripe + hover-reveal of full pin icon. less visual noise but still scannable. Needs accessible contrast.
a11y-bot: Accessibility check: left accent must meet 3:1 contrast ratio. If the stripe color fails contrast at 2px, increase to 3-4px. Also add aria-pressed on the pin control and aria-roledescription="pinned row" on the row container for screen reader discovery.
Asha Mehta: UX microcopy: Hover tooltip should read: "Pinned to model version v3.2.1". For SR users add aria-label on the control: "Pinned to version v3.2.1. Toggle pin".
Logan Price: also in compact rows the action chevrons overlap performance badge tooltips when density is tight. We should increase the tooltip z-index and add a small show-delay (100ms) to reduce flicker when moving mouse between badge and chevron.
Tao Chen: implementation note: chevrons render in a portal which causes stacking context issues. Options: render badges/actions into same stacking context or give portal explicit z-index and hide portal while tooltip open. I'll try a patch to set portal z-index to 1200 and add pointer-delay on tooltip.
Maya Bennett: hit target for chevrons is only 18px right now; a11y wants 24px. we can keep visual density but expand transparent padding.
a11y-bot: For keyboard: ensure tab order visits the pin control before row actions. When tooltip content is read by SR, prefer aria-describedby rather than relying on ephemeral visual tooltip.
Asha Mehta: Action items: Tao -> pr with portal z-index fix + increased chevron hit target; Logan -> update test scenarios and add a small usability note; Maya -> update figma to show 2px stripe fallback rules and hover reveal; a11y-bot -> include checklist for PR (contrast measurement, aria-pressed, aria-roledescription, keyboard order).
Logan Price: will add screenshots and a screencap from the usability session.
Tao Chen: opening draft PR now, will include visual regression snapshots and keyboard test for pin discovery.
Maya Bennett: thanks team, I'll fold the copy changes into the design token file after PR lands.
